app.name: Dr. Kohandezh Assistant
app.tagline: Live conversation with Dr. Kohandezh's digital avatar.
app.offline: You are offline. Audio generation, avatar streaming and recording need a network connection.

states.offline: You are offline. Some data may be out of date.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.description: There is no data to show.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We could not load this data. Check your connection and try again.

auth.title: Log in
auth.subtitle: Enter your phone number to talk to Dr. Kohandezh.
auth.phoneHint: We will send you a one-time code.

errors.otpExpired: This code expired. Request a new one.
errors.otpLocked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
errors.otpRateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
errors.offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet to continue.

hero.title: Talk to Dr. Kohandezh, any time.
hero.description: Ask your question out loud and hear the answer in his own voice, in a live video conversation.

login.title: Log in with your phone
login.description: We send a one-time code by SMS. No password.

mic.title: Allow the microphone
mic.description: Press start and let the browser use your microphone.

talk.title: Speak and listen
talk.description: Ask out loud. The answer comes back in voice and video.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you asked for does not exist.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.description: Your account is not allowed to open this page.

pwa.offlineReady: The app is ready to work offline.

tts.title: Text to speech
tts.label: Persian text
tts.placeholder: Type the sentence the avatar should say…
tts.hint: UTF-8 text, up to 5000 characters. Identical requests are served from the server cache and do not call ElevenLabs again.

session.title: Avatar session
session.closeBlocked: Stop the active recording before closing the session.

video.idle: Start a session to see the avatar here.
video.audioBlocked: Audio is blocked by the browser. Tap to enable playback.
video.label: Avatar video stream

session.configError: The server is not configured for a real LiveAvatar session yet (PUBLIC_LIVEKIT_URL must be a public wss:// endpoint).
session.error: The session could not be started.
session.speakError: Sending text to the avatar failed.

assistant.title: Conversation with Dr. Kohandezh
assistant.subtitle: Press start, allow the microphone, and ask your question out loud.
assistant.offline: You are offline. The conversation needs a network connection.
assistant.languageFallback: The assistant speaks {{language}} for now. Persian is not available from the provider yet.

video.label: Assistant video
video.idle: Press start to see and hear Dr. Kohandezh.

transcript.title: Conversation
transcript.empty: What you and Dr. Kohandezh say appears here.

ended.title: The conversation ended
ended.user: You ended the conversation. You can start a new one.
ended.timeLimit: Trial conversations end after about one minute.
ended.provider: The assistant service closed the session.

errors.title: The conversation could not start
errors.offline: You are offline. Connect to a network and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Log in again.
errors.forbidden: This account is not allowed to use the assistant.
errors.rateLimited: Too many conversations in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.micPermission: The microphone is blocked. Allow microphone access in your browser settings and try again.
errors.micUnavailable: No microphone was found. Connect one and try again.
errors.provider: The assistant service is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again.

recording.title: Recording
recording.needsSession: Start an avatar session before recording.
recording.done: MP4 generated. Manual approval is still required.

unsupported.title: Recording is off in managed mode
unsupported.body: This session runs in LiveAvatar's own LiveKit room, so our Egress worker cannot join it to record. Set LIVEAVATAR_TRANSPORT=byo with a public LiveKit endpoint to record.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.empty: No events yet. Actions and LiveKit events will appear here.
